name: 포세이돈의 바다 궁전
scene: Underwater pearl and turquoise Greek palace, coral along the edges, sunlight through water, distant fish. A marble floor fills the foreground.
english: golden trident on a small coral stand
circular painting of a peaceful underwater palace

name: 아르테미스의 달빛 숲
scene: Moonlit enchanted forest glade, silver birches, lavender sky, crescent moon, mossy stone floor in foreground and a graceful ruined Greek arch.
english: silver bow and quiver on a stand
small luminous crescent tree in a pot

name: 아폴론의 태양 신전
scene: Golden Greek temple interior open to a rosy sunset, pale amber marble, laurel pillars, radiant sun ornament high above. Wide clean floor foreground.
english: circular painting of a sun above a Greek temple

name: 아테나의 지혜 도서관
scene: Dreamlike ancient Greek library, shelves of scrolls and books on side walls, pale sage and ivory marble, high windows, peaceful warm light, open floor foreground.
english: circular painting of an owl and olive branches

name: 데메테르의 꽃 들판
scene: Dreamlike Greek countryside flower meadow courtyard, wheat fields and fruit orchards beyond a stone balustrade, pale peach and sage, abundant flowers along edges, open terracotta floor foreground.
english: small pomegranate tree in a pot
circular painting of flowers and wheat

name: 헤파이스토스의 보석 공방
scene: Cozy magical Greek artisan forge, bronze pipes and gemstone shelves at edges, warm copper and teal, gentle glowing hearth at rear side, open stone floor foreground. Welcoming not industrial.
english: gemstone brazier with gentle orange glow
circular painting of ruby and amber flames

name: 헤르메스의 구름 항구
scene: Floating Greek marble island terrace above fluffy white clouds, sky bridges and distant airships, pale blue gold and cream, elegant wing motifs, open marble floor foreground.
english: leather travel satchel with rolled map
circular painting of floating cloud islands

name: 별빛 천상 궁전
scene: Celestial Greek palace terrace in space, indigo violet and silver, Milky Way beyond curved balustrades, marble star inlays, elegant silver columns at edges, open floor foreground.
english: circular painting of the Milky Way
